report_meta.title: Makro Eastern Cape — Monthly Performance One-Pager
report_meta.subtitle: Eastern Cape Regional Performance

sections.text: Both Eastern Cape Makro stores tracked below target in June, with Gonubie the primary drag at 89.72% on-time against Gqeberha's 94.02%. Courier Delivery SLA Non-Adherence drives 41.53% of all late orders regionally, far more than Store Operations' combined 12.19% contribution, confirming this as a downstream delivery issue rather than a store readiness one -- Pick SLA is strong at both stores (96.92% regionally) and CSAT is stable at 91%. Gqeberha's cancellations are a separate concern worth tracking independently: R279,592 in True Lost value, the largest single financial exposure in this month's numbers.

breakdown.title: Late Order Root Cause (484 Orders, Regional)

executive_facts.statement: Courier Delivery SLA Non-Adherence alone is 41.53% of all late orders -- more than the next two Omni-Digital categories combined -- making the courier partner relationship the single biggest lever for OTD recovery, not in-store execution.

Gonubie's 89.72% on-time rate against Gqeberha's 94.02% makes it the main contributor to the region missing target, but no store-specific Late Order Deep Dive has been supplied for it yet -- the root-cause table reflects the combined regional total, not Gonubie in isolation, so its exact driver mix is still unconfirmed.

Gqeberha's True Lost cancellation value (R279,592) is the largest single financial exposure in this month's numbers and materially exceeds Gonubie's -- this is a distinct issue stream from the OTD/courier problem and should be tracked separately, not folded into the same recovery plan.

Pick SLA and CSAT need no store-level operational intervention this month -- both are healthy at every store -- so recovery effort should concentrate entirely downstream of dispatch, on courier handling and delivery promise management.

sections.text: Escalate Courier Delivery SLA Non-Adherence with the courier partner first -- it's the single largest lever for regional OTD recovery, and everything else this month is a secondary, independently-tracked issue.

provenance.extraction_notes: One-page condensed view of Part A (Makro) of the Eastern Cape monthly regional report. Store-level OTD is shown as a ranking, not a reconciling breakdown, because the source gives each store's late/on-time rate as a percentage of that store's own volume, not a shared count that sums to the regional total -- there is no per-store late-order count in the source to build a true breakdown from. The late-order root-cause breakdown (484 orders) is the combined regional total (Gonubie + Gqeberha), not store-specific -- the source itself flags that a Gonubie-only Deep Dive has not yet been supplied, and this report preserves that same caveat rather than implying store-level attribution that isn't in the data. Recommended Focus Areas from the source (5 items) were condensed to the most material points to fit a one-page format; nothing was added beyond what the source states.
